admission.justification: Prevents later clients from reviving unsupported assessment channels or interpreting their removal as a favorable empty judgment; the history/proof source boundary continues governing review changes.

alternatives.option: Read leaf judgments and after-code proofs in one selected-subject answer; remove old assessment/evidence channels and their test-port scope.
alternatives.reason: History files are the actual judgment source. A new text-storage view must not imply that obsolete unavailable channels still have a producer.

alternatives.option: Keep the old assessment/evidence channels as unavailable placeholders and preserve their direct-treatment tests.
alternatives.reason: The channels have no text-storage carrier and their finite port was explicitly bounded until pane replacement; retaining them continues an unsupported shape.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved requirement introduces a real independently owned channel and its supported source.

alternatives.option: Restore old payload support and compatibility rendering for pre-label assessment fixtures.
alternatives.reason: Pre-label payload support was explicitly refused by the earlier port ruling, and the new four-tree contract removes rather than revives it.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A governing requirement explicitly supports that historical payload and specifies its legitimate producer.

consequences: Read failures stay unavailable and missing judgment fields remain failures, not an invented none result.
The reviewer remains read-only; Curator-coherence publication/validation keeps its separate authority.
context: Tree comparisons read authored leaf history in Git and proof entries; the pre-L57 assessment pane and its finite test-port scope have ended. Approved MIK-R57@v2 rules 1-3 deliberately remove those models, producers and UI channels while preserving Curator-coherence authority.
decider: Approved MIK-R57@v2 under D18, D47 and D48; Curator records the specified choice.
